name: Awesome Materials & Chemistry Datasets
description: Broad discovery list of materials and chemistry datasets; verify each numerical claim at the originating repository.

sources.title: Awesome Materials & Chemistry Datasets
sources.evidence: README groups structural, property, synthesis and other chemistry/materials datasets with links.

name: matminer dataset collection
description: Python loaders and dataset metadata for community materials datasets; retain original dataset citations and licences.

sources.title: matminer dataset summary
sources.evidence: Lists experimental and calculated datasets with descriptions and provenance.

sources.title: matminer repository
sources.evidence: Requests citation of original sources when using loaded datasets.

name: NIMS MatNavi
description: Registered browsing across inorganic, metallic, thermophysical and other materials databases; mass downloading and scraping prohibited.

sources.title: NIMS MatNavi
sources.evidence: Describes component databases, registration and prohibition of mass data acquisition.

description: Discovery catalogue for materials databases and computational tools, including provider links and openness notes.

sources.evidence: Provider catalogue entry gives COD description and official link.

sources.title: NIMS MatDaCs: AtomWork-Adv
sources.evidence: Provider catalogue entry supplies database scope and access notes.

description: Materials-data publication, discovery and access services; Foundry provides programmatic loading of ML-ready deposits.

sources.evidence: Describes discovery services and Foundry dataset loading.

sources.title: MDF publishing/discovering guides
sources.evidence: Explains data publishing and supported source locations.

name: NIST Materials Data Repository
description: Materials research deposits from NIST and the wider community; terms are defined per provider and collection.

sources.title: NIST Materials Data Repository
sources.evidence: Public searchable materials repository; individual providers define data-use terms and review status varies.

name: SpringerMaterials
description: Commercial curated materials-property platform covering several source collections.

sources.title: SpringerMaterials publisher overview
sources.evidence: Curated properties, figures and graphs platform.

name: Scientific Data materials Data Descriptors
description: Journal descriptors are discovery/provenance documents; linked external repositories hold the actual data.

sources.title: Scientific Data collections
sources.evidence: Lists a collection on characterisation/performance data of energy materials.

sources.title: Scientific Data data policies
sources.evidence: Requires repository deposits; journal does not itself host datasets.

name: Battery Archive
description: Cross-institution battery cycling and disruptive-test data; cell-performance resource adjacent to crystal datasets. Full CSV files requested by email.

sources.title: Battery Archive provider home
sources.evidence: Offers cycling/disruptive-test visualization; complete cell CSVs available by contacting the provider.

name: Digital Hydrogen-S
description: Solid-state hydrogen-storage data portal identified in the supplied review. Primary paper exists; primary content and current portal totals could not be independently inspected.

sources.title: Crossref publisher-deposited Digital Hydrogen-S metadata
sources.evidence: Confirms author paper title, DOI and Elsevier PII S0360319926000716; does not verify database counts.

name: Matbench v0.1 suite
description: Thirteen property-prediction tasks from ten underlying sources; includes both composition-only and structure inputs. The catalogue groups shared structure cohorts and does not sum tasks as unique crystals.

sources.title: Benchmarking Materials Property Prediction Methods
sources.evidence: Thirteen tasks from ten experimental/DFT sources, 312 to 132k samples.

name: Matbench Discovery data sets
description: Registry of model training/reference/test datasets and a discovery-style stability benchmark. User-nominated page returned HTTP 403; its first-party GitHub registry and WBM documentation were used.

sources.title: Matbench Discovery dataset registry
sources.evidence: Registry describes WBM and numerous parent/training datasets; it is navigation/provenance context, not an additive dataset.

name: LeMat-GenBench
description: Evaluates generated crystals using validity, distribution, diversity, novelty, and stability metrics with multi-MLIP/hull configurations; its reference datasets overlap LeMat-Bulk. Framework code is Apache licensed; not an additional crystal count.

sources.title: LeMat-GenBench official README
sources.evidence: Defines benchmark families, LeMat-Bulk novelty reference, input formats and comprehensive_multi_mlip_hull configuration.

name: MatterGen MP-20 reprocessed release
description: PBE-recomputed and element-filtered MP-20 derivative with its own distributed files; keep separate provenance from CDVAE MP-20. Exact file-row count was not verified, so not added as an independently sized dataset.

sources.title: MatterGen MP-20 data-release README
sources.evidence: Describes CC BY 4.0 parent, excluded elements, PBE recomputation and hull filtering.

name: AFLOW AEL/AGL thermomechanical property libraries
description: Distinct AFLOW workflows exposing elastic tensors/moduli and Debye/thermal estimates through AFLUX. Current property-bearing cohort sizes were not verified; no independent current materials count is claimed.

sources.title: Official AFLOW REST/AFLUX documentation
sources.evidence: Documents AEL elastic and AGL thermal keys; states data free for scientific, academic and non-commercial purposes.

name: Catalysis-Hub / CatHub
description: Open surface-reaction collection with geometries, reaction energies and linked calculations; primary 2019 descriptor reported >100,000 adsorption/reaction energies, which is a historical property count rather than a current count of unique materials.

sources.title: Catalysis-Hub primary data descriptor
sources.evidence: 2019 descriptor documents linked geometries, calculation settings, reaction and activation energies; contributing studies have different scopes.

name: CatApp
description: Legacy reaction/activation-energy table for elementary surface reactions. The ~3,000-reaction scale is historical; CatApp does not supply detailed atomic geometries, so it is a navigation/property resource.

sources.title: CatApp official CMR page
sources.evidence: Provides calculated reaction and activation energies on metal surfaces with the 2012 publication reference.

sources.title: Catalysis-Hub primary descriptor discussion of CatApp
sources.evidence: Explains that CatApp covers more than 3,000 reactions but lacks atomic structures and detailed calculation output.

name: Digital Catalysis Platform (DigCat)
description: Experimental-performance and computational-structure platform. Provider page currently reports >0.4M experimental and >0.4M computational records; a 2024 author preprint reports >400k performance records and >300k structures. Counts are version-dependent and not a unique-material ranking; bulk data license not verified.

sources.title: DigCat provider laboratory page
sources.evidence: Provider reports >0.4 million experimental data and >0.4 million computational data and identifies the current platform/publication.

sources.title: DigCat 2024 author preprint
sources.evidence: Reports >400,000 experimental performance records and >300,000 structures; denominator and release differ from later claims.

name: MOFX-DB
description: Adsorption-data portal aggregating experimental and hypothetical MOFs, COFs and zeolites. Source datasets overlap CoRE, hMOF, ToBaCCo and IZA; portal totals are not additional unique structures.

sources.title: MOFX-DB primary descriptor
sources.evidence: Describes computational adsorption datasets across multiple source families and thermodynamic conditions.
